public_rationale: On February 28, 2025, Ars strongly criticized GPT-4.5's cost and performance [e1]. Howard's harsh reaction that day was conditional on a coding comparison being accurate [e2]. On February 27, Karpathy welcomed subtle improvements while noting limitations in reasoning tasks [e3]. Every's later-updated article describes initial disappointment followed by appreciation, but does not securely establish its original launch-period assessment [e4]. These sources show differing reactions without establishing whether strongly negative overall reviews predominated during February 27–March 1, 2025 [e1, e2, e3, e4].
limitations: The sample does not establish the proportion of launch-period reviews that were strongly negative [e1, e2, e3, e4].
